errors.description: bist_status_q is a multi-bit value produced in bist_clk and sampled directly in sys_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
bist_done_pulse_q is a one-cycle bist_clk pulse consumed directly in sys_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
bist_done_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample sys_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in sys_event_o.
repair_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector repair_mode_q before decoding in sys_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
bist_rst_n is used as data inside sys_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
test_snapshot_q combines bist_clk payload state with sys_clk status state in test_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
